description: C4: Content-Type parity - XML / JSON / text / binary / form-urlencoded

cases.name: XML request with UTF-8 declaration
cases.body: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><buku id="001"><judul>Belajar Pemrograman Web</judul><penulis>John Doe</penulis><tahun>2026</tahun><harga mataUang="IDR">120000</harga></buku>
cases.notes: XML Content-Type with charset parameter must parse correctly (base media type comparison)

cases.name: JSON request with explicit charset
cases.notes: JSON Content-Type with charset parameter - base media type must be recognized

cases.name: plain text request body
cases.body: plain text payload without JSON structure
cases.notes: text/plain Content-Type - webhook should accept and pass through (status/headers only comparison)

cases.name: form-urlencoded body
cases.notes: application/x-www-form-urlencoded - webhook parser must decode into JSON equivalent

cases.name: XML without charset parameter
cases.body: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><buku id="001"><judul>Belajar Pemrograman Web</judul><penulis>John Doe</penulis><tahun>2026</tahun><harga mataUang="IDR">120000</harga></buku>
cases.notes: XML Content-Type without charset - must parse identical to the charset=utf-8 variant (roundtrip equivalence)

cases.name: binary request body
cases.notes: application/octet-stream - the webhook must accept binary bytes without a 415; the echoed body is compared as-is (invalid UTF-8 handling is not normalised away)
